list.title: Observation cycles
list.intro: A cycle has three steps: Pre-form from teacher → Observation (live or video) → Post-debrief with mentor. Every step is time-stamped and signed.
list.empty: No observation cycles match this filter.

nominate.title: Nominate a cycle
nominate.intro: The cycle starts at Nominated; the teacher’s pre-form moves it on. It is visible to the observer you choose, the teacher, and the teacher’s mentor.

errors.invalid: Some of the details are missing or not valid.
errors.invalidField: Some of the details are missing or not valid. Check: {field}.
errors.observer: That observer account is not an active observer. Pick one from the list.
errors.duplicate: Another cycle took that code at the same moment. Please submit again.
errors.failed: The cycle could not be saved. Please try again.

nominate.missingTeachers: There are no active teachers yet, so a cycle cannot be nominated. Add them at <link>Admin → Teachers</link> first.
nominate.missingObservers: There are no active observer accounts yet, so a cycle cannot be nominated. Add them at <link>Admin → Users (role: Observer)</link> first.
nominate.subject: Subject (optional)
nominate.csv: Loading many at once? Use CSV import at <link>Admin → Observation Cycles</link>.

errors.invalidForm: An answer was blank or longer than {max} characters, so nothing was recorded and the cycle has not moved on. Please correct it and submit again.
errors.invalidFormField: "{field}" was blank or longer than {max} characters, so nothing was recorded and the cycle has not moved on. Please correct it and submit again.
errors.invalid_transition: That action can't be performed in the cycle's current status. The page has been refreshed.
errors.note_too_long: A note can be at most {max} characters, so this one was not added. Please shorten it and add it again.
errors.submit_failed: Your answers could not be saved and nothing was recorded. Please try submitting the form again.
errors.cycle_locked: This cycle has been signed off. Its record is closed, so nothing more can be added to it.
errors.invalid_cycle: That cycle reference was not valid.
errors.unknown: That action could not be completed. Please try again.

cycle.evidenceNoneLocked: No video evidence was linked to this cycle.
cycle.evidenceNoneWhatsapp: No video evidence linked yet. The teacher uploads it below, or sends it by WhatsApp with the caption <kbd>{caption}</kbd>.
cycle.evidenceNone: No video evidence linked yet. The teacher uploads it below.
cycle.lockedEvidence: Signed off — this record is closed and accepts no further evidence.
cycle.recordOrWhatsapp: Record on a phone, or send by WhatsApp →
cycle.newNotePlaceholder: Add a note. Existing notes are kept above.

submitted.byOnBehalf: Submitted by {name} on behalf of the teacher
submitted.byRemovedOnBehalf: Submitted by a removed account on behalf of the teacher

assigned.subject: You have been added to an observation cycle
assigned.body: Open it to see which cycle and when; the Observation section asks for its password first.

complete.subject: An observation cycle you are part of has been signed off
complete.body: Its forms and notes stay on the cycle page in the Observation section.
